description: ZKC-Core conformance vectors. TEST-ONLY key material throughout; regenerate with conformance/generate_vectors.py.

cases.description: holder generates a Core KYC proof; verifier accepts it
holder generates the requested jurisdiction inclusion proof
holder generates the requested accreditation-level proof
holder generates source-of-funds membership in the requested set
holder generates tax-residency membership for the requested year
holder generates sanctions clearance against the requested blocked set
Freedom Safeguard 4: holder refuses an unreviewed predicate by default
holder refuses when no credential issuer is in the verifier trust policy
holder refuses an expired credential
holder refuses when it has no matching credential
envelope generated for one session must not verify for another
an envelope missing a required proof type is rejected
Freedom Safeguard 1: an empty verifier trust policy trusts nobody — not even the well-known test issuer

Registry governance safeguard: the credential's issuer key is published in the repo's discovery registry (registry/issuers/), but this verifier's policy does not list it — discovery-registry membership must never substitute for the verifier's key-exact allowlist (the registry is an advisory cache, not a trust anchor)
issuer accumulator advanced (e.g. revocation) after generation

a revoked credential proves membership only in its holder's self-made one-leaf tree at the issuer's current epoch; the verifier records the issuer's published root for that epoch and rejects the proof
an honest proof is rejected when the verifier records no issuer root for the proof's accumulator epoch: an unchecked root enforces no revocation, so the verifier fails closed
proof attesting level 1 requirements rejected for a level-3 request
an untouched level-1 proof is rejected when the request shifts requiredLevel by the BN254 modulus instead of naming a canonical u8
an untouched jurisdiction inclusion proof is rejected for an internally valid exclusion request over the same credential
an untouched level-2 accreditation proof is rejected for a level-3 request that the credential could otherwise satisfy
an untouched source proof for the singleton set is rejected for a different valid set that still contains the credential code
an untouched tax-year-2025 proof is rejected for a tax-year-2026 request that the credential could otherwise satisfy
an untouched sanctions proof is rejected for a different, self-consistent blocked set under which the subject is also clear
Safeguard 6: holder answers a valid purpose-bound Authenticated Proof Request; verifier accepts under the authenticated path
Safeguard 6: a conforming SDK refuses by default to generate a proof for a request that is not a validly signed APR
Safeguard 6: a billing-purpose proof presented to an access-purpose request is rejected with PURPOSE_MISMATCH
Safeguard 6: a Disclosure Receipt round-trips — a third party verifies the verifier and holder signatures with no operator, issuer, or registry in the loop
Safeguard 6: a receipt whose bound contextValue is altered fails third-party verification
Safeguard 6: a hosted SDK answering on the holder's behalf hands the receipt back and retains nothing
